title: Time-series line with missing-value gaps
intent: Render one chronological series while preserving two explicit null observations as visible gaps rather than filtering or interpolating across them.

source.title: Observable Plot line mark — missing data

ai.create: Create a responsive UTC time-series chart from rows shaped as {id, date, value: number | null}. Render one logical line and preserve two null observations as gaps without filtering the rows, casting a channel, or suppressing a type error.
ai.maintain: Change the missing observations into two multi-row missing runs. Keep the gaps visible across updates, preserve stable keys and inferred datum types, and keep the compact and wide layouts readable.
